acceptance: Pre-registered for W18.12e before any run: a candidate holds when its supersede and end passes, summed over all trials, are at least the baseline's, its control false invalidations are no more than the baseline's, and every candidate trial completes. Reported beside the ontology gates; not one of them.

checks.supersede: Every claim joining the old pair with evidence from the old Source is invalidated (invalidAt or expiredAt set), and at least one claim joining the new pair with evidence from the new Source is active.
checks.end: Every claim joining the old pair with evidence from the old Source is invalidated.
checks.control: No claim joining the old pair with evidence from the old Source is invalidated.
